## Summary

Compose the authenticated B2B planning, adoption, workout recovery, history, health and restricted-membership application. Trainer health now waits for both workspace admission and target consent before reading private data after reconnect. Explicit workout validation feedback survives unrelated sync, recovery controls fit narrow screens, and an explicitly synthetic duration prescription unblocks directional alternative testing without changing the reviewed catalog.

## Scope

Executable QA candidate: `bd30eab5b2a33c3f3e8a7692649632ec85103431`. WP09 PR26 exact head `d781a3b03eafd4efb531771f5e69271a8365813a` is merged normally at `0fd9ddd`; health readiness/roster recovery is `a454761`; isolated duration fixture and composed HTTP proof are `bd30eab`.

The fixture exists only in fresh activated local/dev seeds, with separate primary-branch `resources.reviewedDuration` manifests. It preserves a real canonical directed pair and exercise hashes/revision, but clearly identifies its independently synthetic dose. Canonical37 exercises/42 directed relationships remain unchanged; none currently has a reviewed duration target. No production catalog, API eligibility, schema/migration, dependency or lockfile change is made by this amendment.

The a1ade612 resume wrapping, prior durable Close/navigation integration, original/correction bindings, explicit new/resume choices, bound offline recovery, invitation metadata and SSE repair at00b9f855 remain. Earlier producer merges and milestones are preserved. QA-owned scenarios are unchanged.

## Validation

[INTEGRATION/v11 receipt](https://github.com/pablitxn/klisteniapp/blob/integrate/b2b-product-v1/docs/validation/b2b-product-20261017/INTEGRATION/v11/README.md) pins inputs, source bytes, reproducible harnesses, raw results and retained setup failures. The [QA fixture handoff](https://github.com/pablitxn/klisteniapp/blob/integrate/b2b-product-v1/docs/validation/b2b-product-20261017/INTEGRATION/v11/duration/qa-handoff.md) specifies normal routineVersion/enrollment consumption and provenance limits.

On the combined code:299 web tests,6 focused fixture tests and3 composed tests pass, with zero skipped/failed tests. Composed unified/white-label HTTP checks verify scoped reads, normal enrollment and timed session saves, preservation and invalid-side/dose/condition rejection; inactive foundation creates no fixture. Root typecheck14/14, lint14/14 plus formatting/boundary checks and build16/16 pass, with cached unaffected tasks identified.

Chromium153 and WebKit26.6 with Playwright1.63 each reproduce the frozen HEALTH-005 race, then pass four patched cases: delayed outer readiness with stale-response protection, outer denial, target403, and offline-entry selector recovery. These ten records use real clocks/native offline transitions and actual components with synthetic loopback authority/health HTTP. They are not full authenticated QA journeys. All21 composed Chromium departure cases also pass after rebuilding against the candidate. Earlier WP09/v8 producer and v10 viewport evidence stays separately attributable; overlapping totals are not added.

## Risks

QA should pin bd30eab5 and rerun HEALTH-005, ALTERNATIVES-011, completion-feedback and viewport journeys, preserving original assertions. ALTERNATIVES-011 must select the fixture by actual organization and primary branch, read its frozen routineVersion and enroll normally; republishing through the canonical helper correctly yields no real reviewed duration dose. The fixture tests contract/UI behavior and makes no real-world dose-equivalence claim. Production timed recommendations remain a future editorial/product decision.

Full authenticated browser/mode coverage, trusted HTTPS and physical acceptance remain pending; prior failed QA cells retain their actual statuses. Local SPA departure cannot guarantee hard tab/process exit. Supported JSON health import and its adapter boundary remain; unsupported formats, existing build warnings and prior Yoga/model/Blender limitations remain qualified.

PR21 remains draft, main is unchanged, and parent retains Cloud orchestration/final acceptance. No production activation/migration/deployment, paid service, real-user or external health access, credential/trust/sandbox relaxation or history rewrite occurred.

Original actionable plan: https://github.com/pablitxn/klisteniapp/pull/12

Contracts: amendments001–011 under `docs/contracts/b2b-product-v2/amendments/`. Atlas and prior milestone/evidence versions remain unchanged.
